Definition: to swell up (literally or figuratively, active or passive); by implication, to favor or honour, be high or proud
BiblicalUsage: 1) to honour, adorn, glorify, be high; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to swell; 1a1a) swelling (pass participle); 1a2) to honour, pay honour to, show partiality; 1a3) to adorn; 1a3a) adorned (pass participle); 1b) (Niphal) to be honoured; 1c) (Hithpael) to honour oneself, claim honour
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
